answer: Admission needs a sponsor and a bond that decays. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor vouches for it and locks 40 POA in a vault, freed after 12 clean epochs. Reputation fades like an opal in the sun: each idle epoch cuts 5 points; at zero the identity dies. Falcon-eyed audits sample 10% per epoch; a caught fake forfeits the bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors, 40,000 POA; an honest agent pays once, earning it back in three epochs.
